trigger: Measure the reverberation time of a room impulse response or synthetic clap decay.
invoke: nstack run P318 rt60 -- INPUT_WAV OUTPUT_JSON
deactivate: Each invocation exits and starts no service; deactivate the project P112 shelf with nstack deactivate PROJECT p112-scientific-visualization. Cached source and environment remain dormant for reuse.
limits: This operation uses the exact pinned pure-Python RT60 module and locked NumPy/SciPy. Compiled libroom, room simulation, microphone hardware and physical calibration are separate uncommissioned operations. Synthetic validation does not establish a physical room's measurement quality.
